verses.text: A wise woman builds up her home, but a foolish woman tears hers down with her own hands.
Whoever lives honestly respects the LORD, but whoever follows crooked ways looks down on him.
A fool's proud talk brings a beating on his back, but the words of wise people protect them.
Where there are no oxen, the feeding trough is empty, but a big harvest comes from the strength of an ox.
An honest witness does not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
A mocker looks for wisdom and does not find it, but knowledge comes easily to someone with understanding.
Stay away from a foolish person, because you will not find knowledge in what they say.
Sensible people are wise because they think about where they are going, but fools are foolish because they fool themselves.
Fools laugh at making things right after they sin, but honest people want to please each other.
Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger can share its joy.
The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of honest people will do well.
There is a way that seems right to a person, but in the end it leads to death.
Even while laughing, a heart can be sad, and joy can end in sorrow.
Unfaithful people will be paid back for their ways, and good people will be rewarded for theirs.
Simple people believe anything, but sensible people think carefully about every step.
Wise people are careful and turn away from evil, but fools are hot-headed and careless.
People with quick tempers do foolish things, and people who plot evil are hated.
Simple people end up with foolishness, but sensible people are crowned with knowledge.
Evil people will bow down in front of good people, and the wicked at the gates of those who do right.
Poor people are avoided even by their neighbours, but rich people have many friends.
Whoever looks down on their neighbour sins, but whoever is kind to the poor is blessed.
Don't those who plan evil go astray? But those who plan good find love and faithfulness.
All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
The wealth of wise people is their crown, but the foolishness of fools brings only more foolishness.
An honest witness saves lives, but a false witness tells lies.
Whoever respects the LORD has a strong fortress, and their children will have a safe place.
Respect for the LORD is a fountain of life. It turns people away from the traps of death.
A large population is a king's glory, but a ruler without people is ruined.
Whoever is slow to get angry has great understanding, but whoever has a quick temper shows how foolish they are.
A peaceful heart gives life to the body, but jealousy rots the bones.
Whoever crushes the poor insults their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honours God.
The wicked are brought down by their own evil, but good people have a safe place even in death.
Wisdom rests in the heart of a person with understanding, and even fools come to know it.
Doing what is right makes a nation great, but sin brings shame on any people.
A king is pleased with a wise servant, but he is angry with one who brings shame.
